Activate the shield immediately.''"
"''Uh… The, uh, mekneks are on it, Captain.|Blex and Queya|audio=Blex-ActivateShields-LostFound.flac|{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}}} '''Queya''' was the [[Neimoidian]] [[Executive officer|Chief Officer]] of the [[Trade Federation]] [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2250 ''Whydah''-class Yield Conveyer]] ''[[Fallon]]'' during the [[High Republic Era]]. An ambitious [[officer]], she served under [[Captain]] [[Blex]] and helped to clean up his missteps while awaiting transfer to another [[Starship|vessel]]. In [[132 BBY]], she was on the ''Fallon's'' [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] while he complained about repairs to the [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]] taking too long and reminded him that [[meknek]]s were still working on it. When the [[Jedi]] [[Yord Fandar]] and [[Tasi Lowa]] arrived to arrest the meknek [[Verosha Aniseya]], Queya initially groaned at their presence, but provided them with Aniseya's location when Fandar prepared to use [[the Force]] on Blex. ==Biography== {{Quote|Sub-level. Bunk 23.''"
"''Thank you for your "cooperation."|Queya reveals Verosha Aniseya's location to Yord Fandar|audio=Queya-Yord-LostFound.flac|}} [[File:Queya-Blex-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Wearing dark robes and a tall hat, Queya gestures with her hands while speaking to Blex on the bridge of the ''Fallon''.|Queya served as First Mate to Captain Blex.]] Queya was a [[Neimoidian]] who served the [[Trade Federation]] as a [[merchant]] [[fleet]] [[officer]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} she served as [[Executive officer|Chief Officer]] and [[First Mate]] under [[Captain]] [[Blex]] on board the [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class Yield Conveyer]] ''[[Fallon]]'', which was used as a [[Transport|cargo vessel]]. When the [[Starship|ship]] needed its [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]] repaired, the [[meknek]]s [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Fillik]] were sent onto the ''Fallon's'' surface while it was in [[Realspace|space]] to carry out the maintenance. The use of mekneks violated [[Galactic Republic]] legislation stating that only [[droid]]s could perform outer ship repairs, but Blex had begun cutting corners to try and ensure a profitable run. When the captain complained about how long the repairs were taking and demanded the shields be activated at once, Queya informed him that the mekneks were still working, prompting him to call them disposable. Aniseya, who could hear the conversation on the bridge over [[Comlink|comms]] then responded, causing Blex to groan. A [[Jedi Vector]] then approached the ''Fallon'' and circled in front of the bridge, where Queya recognized it as a [[Jedi]] vessel with surprise. Both she and Blex then groaned. [[File:Jedi-Neimoidians-Fallon-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Yord Fandar and Tasi Lowa, wearing bright white and gold Jedi robes, stand stiffly listening to Blex speak on the bride of the ''Fallon''. Queya stands off to the side, her hands clasped.|Queya provided the Jedi with Verosha Aniseya's location when Yord Fandar prepared to use the Force on Blex.]] Once the [[starfighter]] docked, the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Yord Fandar]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Tasi Lowa]], made their way to the bridge and informed Blex and Queya that they were looking for Aniseya. Queya whimpered, drawing Lowa's attention, as Blex denied there being any passengers or mekneks on board the ''Fallon''. Fandar eventually cut off Blex's lies by raising his [[Limb|hand]] to use [[the Force]], but Queya quickly interjected and provided the location of [[Bunk 23|Aniseya's bunk]]. The two Jedi then left and arrested Aniseya, transferring her to the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'',{{Databank|palwick-prison-ship|Palwick prison ship}} when it docked with the ''Fallon''. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Jedi?''"
"''Ugh.''"
"''Ugh.|Queya and Blex|audio=Neimoidians-JediUgh-LostFound.flac|}} Queya was an ambitious officer who was disappointed by Blex's lack of foresight or strategy, helping to cover up his missteps on the ''Fallon'' until she could secure a transfer to another vessel. She was unpleasantly surprised to see the Jedi, but aided them to prevent Fandar using the Force on Blex. She had [[Color|green]] skin and red [[eye]]s. ==Skills and abilities== Queya could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard|Galactic Basic]] and the secret gestural [[Pak Pak]] [[language]]. ==Equipment== Queya wore a black First Mate's command [[hat]] with a gold lining and black and navy [[Clothing|robes]] made of [[velvoid]] with a crushed pile finish and a silver trim that denoted her rank. ==Behind the scenes== Queya was portrayed by performance artist [[Benedict Stewardson]] in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} The scenes on the ''Fallon'' were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Prior to the release of the episode, Queya was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} The episode's credits only identified the character as "Neimoidian Officer," and she was first named in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''. ==Appearances==
